interface_and_fields: Advanced Search; TS= (title, abstract, author keywords and Keywords Plus); hyphenated forms added explicitly
string: TS=("behaviour driven development" OR "behavior driven development" OR "behaviour-driven development" OR "behavior-driven development" OR Gherkin OR (Cucumber AND (scenario* OR "step definition*"))) AND TS=(quality OR smell* OR metric* OR duplicat* OR maintenance OR maintainab* OR refactor* OR evolution)
targets_found: Binamungu et al. 2018; Binamungu et al. 2020; Binamungu and Maro 2023
problems: TS= also searches Keywords Plus, which is slightly wider than the keywords named in the protocol. Truncation inside quotes works as phrase truncation: TS=("step definition*") returned 43 records and TS=("step definition" OR "step definitions") returned 41; the 2 extra records contain "step definitional". The results page loads records as the page is scrolled, so all three control studies appear only after scrolling.

interface_and_fields: arXiv API (export.arxiv.org/api); ti: and abs: on each term; all archives
string: https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?max_results=500&search_query=(ti:"behaviour driven development" OR abs:"behaviour driven development" OR ti:"behavior driven development" OR abs:"behavior driven development" OR ti:Gherkin OR abs:Gherkin OR ((ti:Cucumber OR abs:Cucumber) AND (ti:scenario* OR abs:scenario* OR ti:"step definition*" OR abs:"step definition*"))) AND (ti:quality OR abs:quality OR ti:smell* OR abs:smell* OR ti:metric* OR abs:metric* OR ti:duplicat* OR abs:duplicat* OR ti:maintenance OR abs:maintenance OR ti:maintainab* OR abs:maintainab* OR ti:refactor* OR abs:refactor* OR ti:evolution OR abs:evolution)
targets_found: Mughal et al. 2026a (also the arXiv versions of Binamungu and Maro 2023 and Mughal et al. 2026b)
problems: The arxiv.org web search returned 0 results: it does not accept nested Boolean queries and it searched only the cs archive, so the API was used. The API treats hyphens as spaces (abs:"behavior-driven development" and abs:"behavior driven development" both returned 27). Truncation inside quotes gives the same result as the explicit forms: abs:"step definition*", abs:"step definition" and abs:"step definitions" each returned 9, because the API already matches plural forms.

interface_and_fields: Command Search; field tag on each term (Document Title, Abstract, Author Keywords)
string: ("Document Title":"behaviour driven development" OR "Abstract":"behaviour driven development" OR "Author Keywords":"behaviour driven development" OR "Document Title":"behavior driven development" OR "Abstract":"behavior driven development" OR "Author Keywords":"behavior driven development" OR "Document Title":Gherkin OR "Abstract":Gherkin OR "Author Keywords":Gherkin OR (("Document Title":Cucumber OR "Abstract":Cucumber OR "Author Keywords":Cucumber) AND ("Document Title":scenario OR "Abstract":scenario OR "Author Keywords":scenario OR "Document Title":"step definition" OR "Abstract":"step definition" OR "Author Keywords":"step definition"))) AND ("Document Title":quality OR "Abstract":quality OR "Author Keywords":quality OR "Document Title":smell OR "Abstract":smell OR "Author Keywords":smell OR "Document Title":metric OR "Abstract":metric OR "Author Keywords":metric OR "Document Title":duplicat* OR "Abstract":duplicat* OR "Author Keywords":duplicat* OR "Document Title":maintenance OR "Abstract":maintenance OR "Author Keywords":maintenance OR "Document Title":maintainab* OR "Abstract":maintainab* OR "Author Keywords":maintainab* OR "Document Title":refactor* OR "Abstract":refactor* OR "Author Keywords":refactor* OR "Document Title":evolution OR "Abstract":evolution OR "Author Keywords":evolution)
problems: The generic string without field tags returned 116 records, but it searches All Metadata, which is wider than the protocol fields. A field tag followed by a bracketed group (e.g. "Abstract":(a OR b)) returned 0 results, so the field tag is repeated on each term. Truncation inside quotes does not work as phrase truncation: "Abstract":"step definition*" returned 14 records, while "step definition" and "step definitions" returned 7 each; the extra records contain "step" and "definition" separately (e.g. the STEP standard). The IEEE string therefore uses "step definition" without truncation, and stemming covers the plural. Binamungu et al. 2020 (Springer) and Binamungu and Maro 2023 (Elsevier) are not indexed in IEEE Xplore (title search returned 0).

interface_and_fields: Advanced Search, ACM Full-Text Collection; Title, Abstract and Keyword fields
string: (Title:("behaviour driven development" OR "behavior driven development" OR Gherkin) OR Abstract:("behaviour driven development" OR "behavior driven development" OR Gherkin) OR Keyword:("behaviour driven development" OR "behavior driven development" OR Gherkin) OR ((Title:(Cucumber) OR Abstract:(Cucumber) OR Keyword:(Cucumber)) AND (Title:(scenario* OR "step definition") OR Abstract:(scenario* OR "step definition") OR Keyword:(scenario* OR "step definition")))) AND (Title:(quality OR smell* OR metric* OR duplicat* OR maintenance OR maintainab* OR refactor* OR evolution) OR Abstract:(quality OR smell* OR metric* OR duplicat* OR maintenance OR maintainab* OR refactor* OR evolution) OR Keyword:(quality OR smell* OR metric* OR duplicat* OR maintenance OR maintainab* OR refactor* OR evolution))
problems: The generic string without field tags returned 659 records because it searches all fields, including full text; restricting to Title, Abstract and Keyword returned 62. ACM search tips: unquoted words are combined with AND, quoted text is an exact phrase, and quote types must not be mixed. None of the control studies is indexed in the ACM Full-Text Collection: a title search for each of Binamungu et al. 2018, Binamungu et al. 2020, Binamungu and Maro 2023 and Mughal et al. 2026a returned 0 records, so their absence is not a failure of the string. Truncation inside quotes was not tested in ACM; the ACM string uses "step definition" without truncation.
